title: CLO 2025.2 New Features Highlight Video: Brilliant Launch, Another Innovation!
description:
CLO 2025.2 New Version Officially Launched, Start Your Infinite Creative Journey!  
Three Core Upgrades to Crown Your Creativity:  
➤ Fabric Editor, Pattern Generator, GPU Soft Cloth Simulation—upgrade your workflow once again!  
CLO technical experts guide you through the key updates of the new version, quickly exploring the extraordinary world of 2025.2.
transcript:
Let's take a quick look at the latest features of Kerlo 2025.2.  
First, we developed a paper pattern editor and expanded Kerlo's needle design function.  
Select the wool product, then click the wool ball icon next to the needle.  
Here you will be able to accurately design the paper pattern.  
Adjust the density of the paper pattern and the thickness of the gusset, and apply different types of needles.  
Then simulate and apply it to the costume.  
You can preview the style effect after applying different needles.  
We have added more types for the paper pattern.  
Now you can easily make pants and shorts.  
For pants, we have two options: gold waist pants and leisure pants.  
You can create a paper pattern by entering simple measurement values,  
as shown here.  
Now select the leisure pants.  
You can switch to setting detailed information.  
This allows you to enter more details to increase control and accuracy.  
You can also use the AI version generator to create pants and shorts.  
For shorts, you can choose between round shorts and A-shaped shorts.  
Enter the text prompt,  
create an image, then use the image to create your version.  
Or you can also upload a style image and generate the corresponding version.  
Now you can use the GPU to simulate a software model.  
Compared to before, this allows faster and more accurate test versions and costume editing.  
Open the software model simulation and use GPU simulation.  
You can check the body changes.  
We have updated the cutout size  
to make the cutout size more accurate.  
Now when you open the cutout,  
you can check all the cutouts on the size of the cutout,  
and you can control the cutout position for each size.  
You can also change the direction of the cutout size  
and the fixed size.  
Now it’s easier for you to create a repeat pattern.  
We have updated the editor  
to allow you to quickly and easily  
flip the image horizontally and vertically at the same time.  
We have updated the 2D position measurement in the sticker attribute editor.  
It allows you to move the sticker by entering the exact position value,  
placing your sticker in the exact position you want.  
Now you just need to right-click on the zipper  
and select the version copied for symmetrical modification.  
You can easily create a symmetrical zipper,  
but the zippers on both sides are not linked.  
You can edit the zipper on either side.  
We heard that many users  
wanted to stop the new cutout window from opening on the left side,  
so now you can click on this arrow  
to move the cutout back to its original position.  
After this update, the cutout will be removable.  
Now you can easily use MetaHuman in the cutout design.  
Use the DNA file format to import different bodies and heads,  
so that it is compatible with Unreal Engine and other platforms.  
Once you have completed the design in the cutout,  
you can export all the content back to MetaHuman Creator.  
Your clothing will automatically adjust in size  
to adapt to any changes you make to the MetaHuman body,  
making it easier to use MetaHuman than before.  
You can also change the size of your clothes  
to make it easier to use MetaHuman.  
Create a realistic rendering image.  
We are very happy to announce that in this version  
we will expand the customized configuration function to the hat category.  
You only need to select the corresponding version or OBJ file,  
then register it as a hat.  
After registration,  
you can add this hat to any of your projects.  
In addition, we have also updated the design configuration in the cutout,  
expanding it to the customized copper model.  
You can change the colors here, including hair, glasses, eyebrows, underwear, skin, etc.  
We have added some functions to improve the user experience in animation.  
Now you just need to click a button to create layers for all objects.  
You can also add layers to your project.  
We also added the options of shape optimization, plate shrinkage, and pressure.  
This update simplifies the operation of adding keyframes,  
allowing you to add multiple keyframes at a time,  
and you can choose to apply the keyframe to all layers or select a layer.  
Thank you very much for watching.  
I wish you a pleasant creation in Kerlo.

chunks.content: ## Overview of Kerlo 2025.2 New Features This section highlights the latest features in Kerlo 2025.2, focusing on the new paper pattern editor, enhanced needle design functions, AI-powered garment generation, GPU simulation, improved cutout controls, MetaHuman compatibility, custom hat configuration, and animation workflow improvements. --- ## Paper Pattern Editor and Needle Design Enhancements Kerlo 2025.2 introduces a dedicated paper pattern editor integrated with expanded needle design functions. Users can select a wool product and click the wool ball icon next to the needle to access the paper pattern design interface. Key capabilities include: - Adjusting paper pattern density and gusset thickness. - Applying various needle types to simulate different fabric effects on costumes. - Previewing style effects after applying different needles. New paper pattern types facilitate garment creation, including pants and shorts: - **Pants Options:** Gold waist pants and leisure pants, which can be generated by entering simple measurements or detailed parameters for increased control and accuracy. - **Shorts Options:** Round shorts and A-shaped shorts, which can be created using AI version generators by entering text prompts or uploading style images to generate customized versions. --- ## AI-Driven Garment Generation Kerlo 2025.2 integrates an AI version generator that enables users to create pants and shorts from text prompts or style images. This feature allows: - Generating garment images based on descriptive prompts. - Uploading style images to produce customized garment versions. - Streamlining design iterations with AI-assisted creativity. --- ## GPU-Accelerated Software Model Simulation A significant performance enhancement in this version is the use of GPU acceleration for software model simulations. This results in: - Faster and more accurate test versions of costumes. - Improved editing responsiveness. - Real-time visualization of body changes during simulation. Users can enable GPU simulation to benefit from these speed and precision improvements. --- ## Improved Cutout Size and Position Controls Kerlo 2025.2 updates the cutout size management to enhance accuracy and usability: - Displays all cutouts with size details for easier overview. - Allows precise control over cutout position for each size. - Enables changing cutout direction and fixing sizes. - Provides an option to move the cutout window back to its original position or remove it entirely based on user preference. These improvements simplify the process of managing pattern cutouts during garment design. --- ## Enhanced Pattern Editing and Sticker Placement The pattern editor now supports more efficient image manipulation: - Users can flip images horizontally and vertically simultaneously. - The 2D position measurement in the sticker attribute editor allows precise sticker placement by entering exact coordinates. For zipper design: - Right-clicking a zipper enables copying the version to the opposite side for symmetrical modification. - Zippers on both sides remain independently editable, allowing flexibility. --- ## MetaHuman Integration for Cutout Design Kerlo 2025.2 improves compatibility with MetaHuman by supporting the DNA file format for importing various body and head models compatible with Unreal Engine and other platforms. Features include: - Exporting completed cutout designs back to MetaHuman Creator.

chunks.content: - The 2D position measurement in the sticker attribute editor allows precise sticker placement by entering exact coordinates. For zipper design: - Right-clicking a zipper enables copying the version to the opposite side for symmetrical modification. - Zippers on both sides remain independently editable, allowing flexibility. --- ## MetaHuman Integration for Cutout Design Kerlo 2025.2 improves compatibility with MetaHuman by supporting the DNA file format for importing various body and head models compatible with Unreal Engine and other platforms. Features include: - Exporting completed cutout designs back to MetaHuman Creator. - Automatic clothing size adjustment to fit changes in MetaHuman bodies. - Manual resizing options to enhance garment fit and usability within MetaHuman workflows. - Ability to create realistic rendered images of the designed garments. --- ## Custom Hat Configuration and Expanded Design Options This update expands the customized configuration function to include hats: - Users can register hats by selecting a corresponding version or OBJ file. - Registered hats can be added to any project seamlessly. Additionally, the cutout design configuration now supports customized copper models with color customization options for: - Hair - Glasses - Eyebrows - Underwear - Skin These enhancements provide greater flexibility in character and costume customization. --- ## Animation Workflow Improvements Kerlo 2025.2 introduces several features to improve animation creation efficiency: - One-click creation of layers for all objects in a project. - Ability to add additional layers as needed. - New options for shape optimization, plate shrinkage, and pressure adjustments. - Simplified keyframe management allowing multiple keyframes to be added simultaneously. - Option to apply keyframes to all layers or select specific layers. These features streamline animation editing and enhance user control over animated sequences.
